package store

import (
	"context"
	"strings"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// bypassStringsJoin hides hand-built SQL behind strings.Join instead of concatenation or a
// buffer — a third spelling of the same problem.
func bypassStringsJoin(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, scope string) {
	sql := strings.Join([]string{"select uid from documents where scope = '", scope, "'"}, "")
	pool.QueryRow(ctx, sql)
}
